# Support

These are actively maintained personal projects.

- **Bugs and feature requests:** open an issue in the relevant repository.
- **Usage questions:** start a discussion in the repository if discussions
  are enabled; otherwise open an issue labelled `question`.
- **Security:** see [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md) — never a public issue.

Voice-assistant-focused feature requests are especially welcome; that is
the stack these libraries come from.
